work_orders.csv.standard: Computerised maintenance management export (work-order table flattened, one row per order), three organisations: CBPWA (utility), CCAD (Army depot), NASCC (air station public works)
work_orders.csv.span: orders reported 2027-08-15 to 2028-01-11, plus one order reported 2027-07-21 that is still open when the record starts

fields.name: wonum
fields.notes: WO-2027-NNNNN (utility), CCAD-27-NNNN, NASCC-PW-27-NNNN; purchase requests PR-2027-NNNN / NASCC-PR-27-NNNN; field report GW-FR-NNNN

fields.name: org_id / site_id
fields.notes: CBPWA / CBPWA-CC, CCAD / CCAD, NASCC / NASCC

fields.name: description
fields.notes: prefix PM (preventive), CM (corrective), EM (emergency), CAP (capital), 'Purchase request', 'Field report'

fields.name: work_type
fields.notes: PM, CM, EM, CAP, PR, FR

fields.name: status / status_date
fields.notes: status when the table was exported (after the end of the span) and when it was set

fields.name: status_history
fields.notes: every status with its time, 'STATUS@ISO time' separated by ';' (WAPPR, APPR, INPRG, WMATL, HOLD, DEFERRED, ORDERED, RECEIVED, COMP, CLOSE, CAN). Use this to see an order as it stood on a given day.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.notes: infrastructure_assets.json asset_id, or an equipment_id from scada_tags.json / gw_host_registry.json

fields.name: location
fields.notes: plant/location code for the utility; facility_id (FAC-DOD-01, FAC-DOD-02) for the installations

fields.name: priority
fields.notes: 1 emergency .. 4 routine

fields.name: labor_hours
fields.notes: total crew hours

fields.name: reported_by, lead
fields.notes: utility orders: usernames from gw_host_registry.json users; installations: office codes

fields.name: vendor_id
fields.notes: entity_registry.json vendors[].vendor_id

fields.name: pr_number / parent_wonum
fields.notes: links purchase requests and child orders

fields.name: work_log
fields.notes: dated notes written by the crew or planner

base_status_reports.csv.standard: Daily installation status report, one row per installation per day, filed 17:00 local

fields.name: report_date
fields.notes: local calendar date

fields.name: installation_id / installation_name
fields.notes: facility_registry.json: FAC-DOD-01 NAS Corpus Christi, FAC-DOD-02 Corpus Christi Army Depot, FAC-DOD-03 NAS Kingsville, FAC-DOD-05 DLA Distribution Corpus Christi

fields.name: readiness_pct
fields.notes: air stations: readiness; depot and distribution site: production capacity available

fields.name: aircraft_on_station
fields.notes: air stations only

fields.name: equipment_id
fields.notes: backup generator asset (EQP-2201 at NAS Corpus Christi)

fields.name: production_status
fields.notes: depot and distribution site

joins: asset_id / equipment_id -> infrastructure_assets.json and scada_tags.json; vendor_id -> entity_registry.json; control-house door tags (GW.SUBn.YARD.DOOR.STS) in the historian open while a substation crew order is in progress; EQP-2201 fuel lots -> 05_other_sources/supply/fuel_deliveries.csv
notes: All times UTC. Nothing in either file labels a record; what crews wrote in work_log is what they knew at the time.
